verdict.rationale: Unit's marketing/docs pages repeatedly reference building 'directly on the Unit Platform using APIs' and link to 'Explore the API,' confirming it is fundamentally an API-first BaaS platform, but there is no evidence of an actual public API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger spec, or markdown-based docs — probes for openapi.json, swagger.json, and docs/api/.md all returned 404. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/spec file, concrete API reference documentation, and any AI-native tooling (SDKs, docs-as-markdown) confirming programmatic/agent-friendly access.
